html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A new saga begins, centered around the immortal beings 
who reside in the sacred realm known as Olympus!

 

In this Update Details, we introduce the November Update, 
featuring the Immortals of Olympus inspired theme.

 

The formidable powerhouse Hercules and the god of the dead Hades (Pluto), 
both with Tier-3 and Tier-4 abilities, make their first appearances,
alongside the supreme ruler of Olympus Zeus with Tier-3 abilities. 
In addition, Athena, the goddess of wisdom and war, 
and Venus (Aphrodite), the goddess of love, 
join the MARVEL Future Fight universe as new heroes.

 

We are also introducing a New Epic Quest 
where you can enjoy the stories of these newly added heroes, 
as well as a new battleground for the Alliance Battle content: 
the Infinite Challenge mode, promising tense and exhilarating battles.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 


▣ Five New Heroes

 

Check out the abilities of 
Hercules <Modern>, who possesses immense strength and a warm heart, 
Hades (Pluto) <Modern>, the absolute sovereign of the underworld, 
Zeus <Modern>, the god of the sky and ruler of Olympus, 
Athena <Incredible Hercules>, an excellent strategist and holder of vast knowledge, 
and Venus (Aphrodite) <Incredible Hercules>, who possesses emotion manipulation abilities centered around love.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Hercules, Hades (Pluto) Tier-3 & Tier-4

 

① Hercules

 

Tier-3 Ultimate Skill has been added for Hercules.
This power will aid him in all the adventures and achievements he will experience.

 

 

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Hercules. 
He will continue to forge ahead on the path of a glorious warrior.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

② Hades (Pluto)

 

As the cold-hearted king of the underworld, he harbors ambitions to rule an even wider domain. 
Check out Hades (Pluto)'s Tier-3 Ultimate Skill!

 

 

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Hades (Pluto). 
He will use this power to further solidify his authority.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Zeus Tier-3

 

Tier-3 Ultimate Skill has been added for Zeus. 
No one will dare stand against the great power of the leader of Olympus.

 

 

 

 

▣ Athena and Venus (Aphrodite) Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Athena and Venus (Aphrodite) will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the November Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ New Epic Quest [Immortals of Olympus]

 

We introduce you to <Immortals of Olympus>,
the new Epic Quest theme added through the November Update. 

 

 

1. Follow the journey of Native Tier-2 hero, Hercules, and watch him grow!

 

- Hercules is a Native Tier-2 hero and can only be upgraded through the Epic Quest. 
- Hercules’s Tier-2 Passive will apply immediately upon acquisition. 
- Hercules can be advanced up to Tier-3 through the Epic Quest Progression Rewards
without a separate Potential Search and Enhancement. 

 

2. Native Tier-2 hero Zeus can be acquired 
when meeting the hero possession/development requirement in The King of the Gods menu. 

 

- Native Tier-2 Zeus will be available for acquisition when upgrading 
all the required heroes on the bottom of the screen to Tier-2 level 60. 

 

3. Special Rewards and exclusive stage benefits will be available
through the Epic Quest - Deluxe Pack or the Special Deluxe Pack. 

 

[Deluxe Pack] - Benefits will be available after purchasing with Crystals.

 

[Special Deluxe Pack] 
Deluxe benefits + 1,000 Crystals and 2,500 VIP points
will be acquired immediately upon in-app purchase. 

 

[Epic Quest: Immortals of Olympus Deluxe Pack Benefits]
1. Story Completion Reward - Deluxe additional rewards available
2. Acquire 6★ Hades (Pluto) instantly
3. Unlock The Lord of Hell mission instantly

 


* The two packages, Epic Quest: Immortals of Olympus - Deluxe 
and Epic Quest: Immortals of Olympus - Special Deluxe
cannot be purchased simultaneously, and can only be purchased once per account. 
* The Epic Quest: Immortals of Olympus - Deluxe benefits will apply immediately 
upon purchase, and Crystal refunds may be unavailable after purchase.
* The Epic Quest: Immortals of Olympus - Special Deluxe effects will apply immediately upon opening the product at the Inbox, and withdrawal of the subscription may be restricted after purchase. 
* The Special stage available after purchasing the two Deluxe packages
will be available even after the Epic Quest is completed.

 

▶ The price of the Deluxe Product and Quest Pack for each existing Epic Quest has been lowered. 
Please check the link below for details. 
Go to → [Epic Quest: Deluxe & Quest Pack Price Reduction Pre-Announcement]

 

4. Special items can be acquired through the Epic Quest Collection <Ancient Greek Library>.
Collection materials can be acquired at a fixed probability when clearing each stage. 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Alliance Battle Mode [Infinite Challenge] Addition and Improvements

 

1. Infinite Challenge Mode

 

Doctor Strange has requested the Agents' help 
to defeat powerful Super Villains threatening the safety of all dimensions beyond the world. 
Please help him protect the peace of the Multiverse!

 

The newly added Infinite Challenge Mode in this update is the new content in Alliance Battle. 
It is structured to continuously battle bosses with difficulty levels higher than World Boss Legend, 
acquiring points by dealing damage or defeating them.

 

 

① With the new addition of the Infinite Challenge Mode, 
the categories of each mode have been subdivided into Boss Battle and Relay Battle, 
and the schedule for progression has been changed as follows:
- Alliance Battle Period: 2 Weeks → 4 Weeks
- Normal/Extreme/Legend Mode Progression Days: Monday - Friday
- Infinite Challenge Mode Progression Days: Saturday - Sunday
* Participation is limited to once per day, and a certain amount of Gold is required to proceed with the Challenge Mode. 
* Infinite Challenge Mode does not require separate conditions for unlocking. 
* When it is not the progression day for each mode, only Training Mode is available. 
* Score reset occurs every Friday at 1:00 (UTC+0), Thursday at 17:00 (PST). 
For Alliance Tournament, the score reset time and progression period remain the same as before.


▶ Please refer to the table below for the entry requirements per round for each mode.
* The weaknesses for each mode will change sequentially on a 28-day cycle.
- Extreme Mode: Silence, Paralyze, Burn 
- Legend Mode: Snare, Shock, Fracture 

 

 

 

② In Infinite Challenge Mode, you will form a team of 3 heroes who meet the participation requirements (Type, Gender, Allies, Ability, etc.) for that round, and sequentially battle 6 bosses.
- During combat, if all heroes become incapacitated, you can use Crystals to Continue, but this function is not available when using Challenge Mode.

 

 

③ In Infinite Challenge Mode, you will sequentially battle 6 bosses for 4 minutes, acquiring scores and bonus time.
- Score: You can acquire points when dealing damage to the boss and additional points when defeating them.
- Bonus Time: This refers to the additional time available for combat beyond the basic 4 minutes, and is acquired if you defeat the boss before the Rage Gauge displayed below the boss's HP charges to 100%.

 

- When the Rage Gauge reaches 100%, bosses will become stronger, and you will not be able to gain bonus time. Dodging the enraged boss’s powerful attacks will temporarily weaken the boss.

 

- After the basic combat time of 4 minutes has elapsed, the battle using the secured bonus time will begin.

 

④ Rewards are distributed based on the score achieved at the end of the battle.
Weekly Ranking Rewards / Weekly MVP Rewards are calculated by summing the highest scores from 
Normal / Extreme / Legend / Infinite Challenge modes.
* Rewards not obtained in Infinite Challenge Mode can be acquired by achieving the necessary score for that reward using Challenge Mode.

 

- The Score Achievement Reward list can only be viewed on the progression day of each mode.

 

▶ Infinite Challenge - Score achievement rewards are as follows.

 

 

⑤ In the Alliance Battle Ranking, the ranking is determined by summing the highest scores of each alliance member from the Normal/Extreme/Legend/Infinite Challenge modes. 
For Alliance Tournament, the top 1st to 16th rankers based on the highest score will advance, same as before.


2. Improvements

 

① Extreme Mode: The Hero Tag Cooldown is now reset upon successfully exploiting the weakness.

 

② Monthly Schedule: The name has been changed from Weekly → Monthly, and a button to adjust in units of 5 rounds has been added.

 

 

③ Alliance Battle Score: A function to check the score acquired in each round has been added.
* 29 days' worth of scores are recorded, and the score from the oldest round is deleted as days pass. 
(How to check: Alliance Battle Main Screen → Tab the icon in the bottom left)

 

3. Relevant Information

 

We have confirmed an issue where point rewards are not being distributed, even after playing the 
Infinite Challenge, when a challenge related to Alliance Battle: Normal is set as a mission in certain events.
▶ Affected Events: Future Pass, Cosmic Core, Timeline Survival
* Please note that the mission count for certain Special Pass / Challenge is being applied normally.

 

We apologize for the inconvenience regarding the event progression 
that will take place after the update on 11/4 (Tue).
As a temporary measure, we have adjusted the acquisition points for the Alliance Battle: Normal event missions.
- Future Pass (Normal): 50 → 80
- Future Pass (Legendary): 60 → 90
- Future Pass (Mythic): 100 → 130
- Cosmic Core Event: 50 → 80
- Timeline Survival Event: 3 → 9

 

* Once the point distribution for Infinite Challenge play is normalized, the increased mission acquisition points will be adjusted back to the original acquisition points.

 


▣ Custom Gear Reforge System Improvement

 

To help Agents proceed more smoothly through various content, 
we have added a Guaranteed Super Success Reforge System 
to ease the difficulty of acquiring Brilliant C.T.P.s.

 

Through this system, when reforging Normal / Mighty C.T.P.s, points will accumulate 
based on the number of additional Reforging Materials added. 
When refining after reaching 100% accumulation, 
you are guaranteed to acquire a Brilliant C.T.P.

 

You can find more details below.
* When reforging, points are accumulated in proportion to the quantity of materials, 
excluding the C.T.P. that is mandatorily required. 
- 1 point is accumulated for every 1 additional C.T.P. material (Mighty C.T.P. and Brilliant C.T.P. also accumulate 1 point each)
Example: Reforging C.T.P. of Rage (Excluding mandatory material, 2 points accumulated)
- Reforging Materials: C.T.P. of Rage (Mandatory Material) + C.T.P. of Insight (1 point), C.T.P. of Judgment (1 point)


* The Guaranteed Super Success Reforge System is a unified system that reflects accumulation across all C.T.P.s, not just the specific C.T.P. being reforged.
* Upon Super Success in reforging, the accumulated 'Next Guaranteed Super Success when charged completely' gauge will be reset.


* Example: Super Success Guaranteed System: Applied / Not Applied
- Applied: Reforging when the 'Next Guaranteed Super Success when charged completely' gauge is 100% or more.
- Not Applied: Reforging when the 'Next Guaranteed Super Success when charged completely' gauge is below 100%.

 

 

 

▣ New Comic Cards and Collection


Five new Comic Cards with the <Fantastic Four Classic> theme have been added. 
Collect these Comic Cards with powerful options and upgrade all of them to Mythic to acquire the 

‘Energy Attack Increase +3%’ effect as a collection reward.
* The following Comic Cards can be acquired at the 

[Store] - [Dimension Chest] - [Comic Card Chest] after the November Update.
* Certain Fantastic Four (1961) themed Comic Cards can also be obtained through gameplay.
* The [Fantastic Four (1961) #49] cannot be acquired from the Premium Comic Card Chest that can be purchased with Premium Comic Card Exchange Tokens. 
* The effects are based on the highest quality and rank.

 

 

 

 

 

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

After the November Update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for 
Hercules, Hades (Pluto), Zeus, Athena and Venus (Aphrodite) will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.


​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, 
and one more from the Deluxe Product (Epic Quest: Immortals of Olympus)!

 

[November Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deal Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 11/4 Maintenance - 12/9 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 11/4 Maintenance - 12/9 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)


- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. World Boss: A function to check whether to use Striker Support Attacks has been added.
- This function is also applied to the Ally Team List.

 

2. Timeline Battle, Team Battle Arena: The following have been revamped.
- Available Entries: 10 times → 5 times (2x rewards)
- Crystal charging amount and count, and related achievement challenge counts have been reduced by half.

 

* Additionally, for details regarding the revamped content, including the available time period and the number of entries on the updated day, please refer to the link below.
[Pre-Notice of Timeline Battle / Team Battle Arena Adjustment] ← Link

 

3. Craft: The default crafting quantity for some items has been increased.

 

4. Story Fragment Conversion: The number of owned fragments is now displayed in the Guaranteed Conversion → Fragment Conversion Results pop-up.

 

5. The Gauge increase rate for Elite Gear Limit Break Success has been adjusted.
- The Level Limit Break Gauge acquisition amount for Success and Super Success has increased from Level 81 onwards.
- Ultra Success will fill the gauge entirely, same as before.

 

6. Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch’s Allies has been changed to Human.
- Their Instinct remains as Order.

 

7. The number of Zombies appearing has been adjusted to ease the difficulty of Zombie Survival.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. World Boss Legend+ (Thanos & Black Order): Fixed an issue where the boss’s type was not applied as Boss after the boss transitioned phase.


2. Emma Frost <Summer Queen>: Fixed an issue where part of the uniform's appearance was not displayed normally.


3. Hulk (Amadeus Cho): Fixed an issue where some effects and modeling were not displayed normally when using Awakened Skill.

 

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
